headline: Names a Chicago post office building after Captain Herbert Johnson, with no change to postal services or rules.
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility at 3349 West 111th Street in Chicago, Illinois, as the "Captain Herbert Johnson Memorial Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, what services it offers, or who it serves.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 16, 2014, and the designation took effect on that date.
